name: Angelo Cesare
source:
An ambitious young man, quite self "made" and willing to climb the social ladder even further—but in a more respectable, law-abiding way this time. Angelo is persuasive, charming and can always be counted upon to take the most garish road possible. Will Gilda be able to keep up with him?

[From [url=https://illegalileo.itch.io/lets-misbehave]itch.io[/url]]
